en: Monochrome postcard showing a cylindrical medieval-style brick tower with a conical roof in a landscaped park. In the foreground there is a pond or moat with a small iron footbridge crossing the water, trees without leaves around it, and an islet. The image is framed in a circular vignette. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as Nijmegen and Kronenburger Park, with publisher and photographer credits.
